info.description:
The API of Platita, a personal and family finance assistant. The dashboard is its only client, and both are served from one origin.

**Session.** It travels in the cookie `__Host-sid`, which the page cannot read. An operation that asks for a session is marked as such, and answers `401` without a valid one.

**Requests that change something.** A `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE` must come from the page of the API itself and be JSON: with another `Origin`, without one, or with another `Content-Type`, it answers `403`.

**Errors.** Every error has the same body: its code in `error`, a short lowercase word that never changes. Every response carries the header `X-Request-Id`, the reference to look for in the logs.
info.title: Platita

get.description: The accounts of the user of the session, each with its balance computed from its movements and transfers dated up to today, in the time zone of the user. The balance is never stored. They come first in the primary currency of the user, then in the other currencies by code, and within each currency by name. An account of type `receivable` is money others owe the user: the dashboard does not list it with the others.

401.description: There is no valid session: missing, unknown, revoked or expired, told apart nowhere.

get.description: The messages of the web chat of the user of the session, what the user wrote and what Platita replied, in the order they happened. With `after`, only the ones that come after that message: it is what the dashboard asks every few seconds. It does not count as activity of the session.
